import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 10, M = 25, S = 1048580, MOD = 1000000007;
    static int n, tot, bin[] = new int[M], a[] = new int[N], b[] = new int[N], f[] = new int[S], g[] = new int[S], id[] = new int[70], pts[][] = new int[M][N], sta[] = new int[M];
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[N];
    static int[][] p = new int[N][N], ma = new int[N][N], qpowCache = new int[2];

    static int qpow(int base, int exp) {
        int res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (int)((long)res * base % MOD);
            base = (int)((long)base * base % MOD);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void setup(Scanner sc) {
        bin[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 20; i++) bin[i] = bin[i - 1] * 2;
        n = sc.nextInt();
        int inv = qpow(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = sc.nextInt();
                p[i][j] = (int)((long)p[i][j] * inv % MOD);
            }
        }
        while (n < 6) {
            n++;
            p[n][n] = 1;
        }
    }

    static boolean can_match(int x) {
        if (x > 3) return true;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
            if (!vis[i] && ma[a[x]][b[i]] != 0) {
                vis[i] = true;
                if (can_match(x + 1)) return true;
                vis[i] = false;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void dfs_explore(int x, int y, int prob) {
        if (x > 3) {
            int sum = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= 3; j++) b[j] = pts[i][j];
                if (can_match(1)) sum += bin[i - 1];
            }
            f[sum] = (int)((f[sum] + (long)prob) % MOD);
            return;
        }
        ma[a[x]][y] = 0;
        if (y == n) {
            dfs_explore(x + 1, 1, (int)((long)prob * (MOD - p[a[x]][y]) % MOD));
        } else {
            dfs_explore(x, y + 1, (int)((long)prob * (MOD - p[a[x]][y]) % MOD));
        }
        ma[a[x]][y] = 1;
        if (y == n) {
            dfs_explore(x + 1, 1, (int)((long)prob * p[a[x]][y] % MOD));
        } else {
            dfs_explore(x, y + 1, (int)((long)prob * p[a[x]][y] % MOD));
        }
    }

    static void generate_states(int x, int y, int s) {
        if (y == 3) {
            id[s] = ++tot;
            sta[tot] = s;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) pts[tot][i] = a[i];
            return;
        }
        if (x > n) return;
        generate_states(x + 1, y, s);
        a[y + 1] = x;
        generate_states(x + 1, y + 1, s + bin[x - 1]);
    }

    static void precompute() {
        for (int i = 0; i < tot; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < bin[tot]; j++) {
                if ((j & bin[i]) != 0) {
                    g[j] = (g[j] + g[j ^ bin[i]]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        setup(sc);
        generate_states(1, 0, 0);
        a[1] = 1; a[2] = 2; a[3] = 3;
        dfs_explore(1, 1, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < bin[tot]; i++) {
            int t = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= tot; j++) {
                int rev = id[bin[n] - 1 - sta[j]];
                if ((i & bin[j - 1]) != 0) t += bin[rev - 1];
            }
            g[t] = f[i];
            f[i] = 0;
        }
        a[1] = 4; a[2] = 5; a[3] = 6;
        dfs_explore(1, 1, 1);
        precompute();
        int result = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < bin[tot]; i++) {
            result = (int)((result + (long)f[i] * g[bin[tot] - 1 - i] % MOD) % MOD);
        }
        System.out.println((1 - result + MOD) % MOD);
        sc.close();
    }
}
